name: grabby
title: nixi
description: Capture what moves. Save video and audio to your Mac.
author: mrm

scripts.lint: eslint src eslint.config.mjs --max-warnings=0 && prettier --check src eslint.config.mjs package.json

commands.name: capture
commands.title: Nixi: Capture
commands.description: Save media from typed or clipboard links, with batch, playlist and format options

commands.name: quick-capture
commands.title: Nixi: Quick Capture
commands.description: Immediately queue clipboard links using your saved defaults

commands.name: extract-audio
commands.title: Nixi: Extract Audio
commands.description: Save only audio from a typed or clipboard media link

commands.name: queue
commands.title: Nixi: Queue
commands.description: Manage active downloads and history, retry failures and reveal saved files

commands.name: open-panel
commands.title: Nixi: Open Panel
commands.description: Open the full nixi web interface
